# Framerock Design System (@tailrocks/framerock)

> Standalone React 19, Base UI, Tailwind CSS v4, and shadcn-compatible design system and component registry extracted and decoupled under Apache-2.0 from the open-source Foglamp project (`foglamp-labs/foglamp` at commit `7d7e6609108019a74902858d4b07c24825c6318b`).

## Attribution & License

- **Original Design & Engineering**: Gustavo Fior (@gustavo-fior — https://gustavofior.com, https://github.com/gustavo-fior, https://x.com/heyimgustavo), co-founder Abdul Haidar (https://www.linkedin.com/in/abdulhdr/), and Foglamp Labs (https://foglamp.dev).
- **Upstream Repository**: https://github.com/foglamp-labs/foglamp (`7d7e6609108019a74902858d4b07c24825c6318b`)
- **License**: Apache License 2.0 (`Apache-2.0`)
- **Standalone Package & Registry Adaptation**: Tailrocks (https://github.com/tailrocks)

## Installation & Registry Endpoints

- **Package**: `@tailrocks/framerock`
- **Stylesheet**: `@tailrocks/framerock/styles/globals.css`
- **Registry Index (shadcn)**: `/r/registry.json` and `/r/framerock.json`
- **Story Provenance Catalog**: `/r/story-items.json`
- **Install Individual Item via CLI**: `npx shadcn@latest add http://localhost:3000/r/<registry-item>.json`

## Foundations & Overview

- [Framerock Design System](/docs): Overview, categories, and open-source origin.
- [Origin, Inspiration & Open-Source Attribution](/docs/credits): Full Apache-2.0 attribution and provenance breakdown.
- [Tokens](/docs/foundations/tokens): OKLCH light and dark color tokens, chart palettes, and elevation variables.
- [Typography](/docs/foundations/typography): Inter Variable, Host Grotesk display, and Geist Mono tabular numeric scales.
- [Geometry & Squircles](/docs/foundations/geometry): Corner superellipse (`corner-squircle`) and radius token rules.
- [Motion](/docs/foundations/motion): Spring and cubic-bezier entrance, hover, and layout choreography.
- [Architecture](/docs/foundations/architecture): Router-agnostic `FramerockLinkProvider` and headless data-prop contracts.
- [Installation](/docs/foundations/installation): Workspace package and shadcn registry installation guide.

## UI Primitives (56 Components)

- [Accordion](/docs/primitives/accordion): Disclosure group for showing related trace, run, or evaluation details. The root supports multiple expanded items, as used by the shipped story. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/accordion`, Registry: [`/r/ui-accordion.json`](/r/ui-accordion.json))
- [Alert Dialog](/docs/primitives/alert-dialog): Modal confirmation flow with a backdrop, title, description, and action or cancel controls. Content size and cancel button styling are exposed by this wrapper. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/alert-dialog`, Registry: [`/r/ui-alert-dialog.json`](/r/ui-alert-dialog.json))
- [Alert](/docs/primitives/alert): Compact status or warning container with separate title, description, and action slots. The wrapper offers default and destructive treatments. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/alert`, Registry: [`/r/ui-alert.json`](/r/ui-alert.json))
- [Aspect Ratio](/docs/primitives/aspect-ratio): Container that keeps its content at a numeric width-to-height ratio. The ratio is required and passed to the underlying div wrapper. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/aspect-ratio`, Registry: [`/r/ui-aspect-ratio.json`](/r/ui-aspect-ratio.json))
- [Avatar](/docs/primitives/avatar): Identity image with a fallback, optional badge, and grouped-avatar layout. The root accepts sizes default, sm, lg, and xs. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/avatar`, Registry: [`/r/ui-avatar.json`](/r/ui-avatar.json))
- [Badge](/docs/primitives/badge): Compact status label with default, semantic color, and outline treatments. Variant and size values come from the exported variant recipe. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/badge`, Registry: [`/r/ui-badge.json`](/r/ui-badge.json))
- [Breadcrumb](/docs/primitives/breadcrumb): Navigation trail built from a nav, ordered list, items, links, current-page label, separator, and overflow marker. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/breadcrumb`, Registry: [`/r/ui-breadcrumb.json`](/r/ui-breadcrumb.json))
- [Button Group](/docs/primitives/button-group): Grouped control row or column with optional text and separator slots. Its orientation variant changes the group layout. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/button-group`, Registry: [`/r/ui-button-group.json`](/r/ui-button-group.json))
- [Button](/docs/primitives/button): Action control with seven visual variants and eight sizes. It preserves Base UI button polymorphism through the render prop and infers native-button behavior when render is absent. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/button`, Registry: [`/r/ui-button.json`](/r/ui-button.json))
- [Calendar](/docs/primitives/calendar): DayPicker calendar with Framerock button styling, chevrons, and range selection states. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/calendar`, Registry: [`/r/ui-calendar.json`](/r/ui-calendar.json))
- [Card](/docs/primitives/card): Content container composed from header, title, description, action, body, and footer slots. The root offers default and compact sizes. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/card`, Registry: [`/r/ui-card.json`](/r/ui-card.json))
- [Carousel](/docs/primitives/carousel): Embla-backed, axis-aware carousel with content, item, previous, and next controls. The root accepts Embla options and plugins and can expose its API through setApi. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/carousel`, Registry: [`/r/ui-carousel.json`](/r/ui-carousel.json))
- [Chart](/docs/primitives/chart): Chart container, tooltip, and legend helpers for Recharts. ChartConfig maps series keys to labels and optional color or icon metadata. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/chart`, Registry: [`/r/ui-chart.json`](/r/ui-chart.json))
- [Checkbox](/docs/primitives/checkbox): Base UI checkbox root with project input-control styling and forwarded checkbox state and accessibility props. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/checkbox`, Registry: [`/r/ui-checkbox.json`](/r/ui-checkbox.json))
- [Collapsible](/docs/primitives/collapsible): Controlled or uncontrolled disclosure root with separate trigger and panel exports. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/collapsible`, Registry: [`/r/ui-collapsible.json`](/r/ui-collapsible.json))
- [Combobox](/docs/primitives/combobox): Searchable selection control with list, group, empty, chip, clear, and separator parts. The input can show a trigger or clear button. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/combobox`, Registry: [`/r/ui-combobox.json`](/r/ui-combobox.json))
- [Command](/docs/primitives/command): Command menu composition built on cmdk, with an optional dialog wrapper, search input, groups, options, empty state, and shortcut label. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/command`, Registry: [`/r/ui-command.json`](/r/ui-command.json))
- [Context Menu](/docs/primitives/context-menu): Right-click menu with nested submenus, checkbox and radio items, labels, separators, and shortcut text. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/context-menu`, Registry: [`/r/ui-context-menu.json`](/r/ui-context-menu.json))
- [Dialog](/docs/primitives/dialog): Modal dialog built from Base UI root, backdrop, popup, title, description, and close parts. The popup shows its close button by default. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/dialog`, Registry: [`/r/ui-dialog.json`](/r/ui-dialog.json))
- [Direction](/docs/primitives/direction): Direction provider and hook used to set or read left-to-right and right-to-left layout context. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/direction`, Registry: [`/r/ui-direction.json`](/r/ui-direction.json))
- [Drawer](/docs/primitives/drawer): Modal drawer composition with trigger, portal, backdrop, content, heading, and footer parts, backed by the project drawer primitive. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/drawer`, Registry: [`/r/ui-drawer.json`](/r/ui-drawer.json))
- [Dropdown Menu](/docs/primitives/dropdown-menu): Positioned menu with groups, nested submenus, checkbox and radio items, labels, separators, and keyboard shortcut text. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/dropdown-menu`, Registry: [`/r/ui-dropdown-menu.json`](/r/ui-dropdown-menu.json))
- [Empty](/docs/primitives/empty): Structured empty state with header, media, title, description, and content slots. Media supports default and icon variants. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/empty`, Registry: [`/r/ui-empty.json`](/r/ui-empty.json))
- [Field](/docs/primitives/field): Form-field composition with fieldset, legend, label, description, error, separator, and layout slots. Field orientation supports vertical, horizontal, and responsive layouts. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/field`, Registry: [`/r/ui-field.json`](/r/ui-field.json))
- [Hover Card](/docs/primitives/hover-card): Preview card opened by a trigger. Its content wrapper exposes popup placement options from Base UI. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/hover-card`, Registry: [`/r/ui-hover-card.json`](/r/ui-hover-card.json))
- [Input Group](/docs/primitives/input-group): Input or textarea composition with aligned addons, buttons, and text. Addon alignment and button size and variant are configurable. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/input-group`, Registry: [`/r/ui-input-group.json`](/r/ui-input-group.json))
- [Input Otp](/docs/primitives/input-otp): OTP input composition with groups, indexed slots, and separators. The root adds a class for the OTP input package container. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/input-otp`, Registry: [`/r/ui-input-otp.json`](/r/ui-input-otp.json))
- [Input](/docs/primitives/input): Styled native input that keeps standard input attributes and forwards its input type and other native props. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/input`, Registry: [`/r/ui-input.json`](/r/ui-input.json))
- [Item](/docs/primitives/item): General-purpose row composition with media, content, actions, header, footer, and separator slots. The root and media slots expose independent variants. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/item`, Registry: [`/r/ui-item.json`](/r/ui-item.json))
- [Kbd](/docs/primitives/kbd): Keyboard-key label and group wrapper for displaying one key or a sequence of keys. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/kbd`, Registry: [`/r/ui-kbd.json`](/r/ui-kbd.json))
- [Label](/docs/primitives/label): Styled native label that forwards standard label attributes. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/label`, Registry: [`/r/ui-label.json`](/r/ui-label.json))
- [Loader](/docs/primitives/loader): Text shimmer indicator with a configurable message, size, and class name. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/loader`, Registry: [`/r/ui-loader.json`](/r/ui-loader.json))
- [Menubar](/docs/primitives/menubar): Horizontal Base UI menubar composed with menu, trigger, popup, item, submenu, radio, checkbox, separator, and shortcut parts. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/menubar`, Registry: [`/r/ui-menubar.json`](/r/ui-menubar.json))
- [Native Select](/docs/primitives/native-select): Styled native select with option and option-group exports. The select supports default and compact sizes. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/native-select`, Registry: [`/r/ui-native-select.json`](/r/ui-native-select.json))
- [Navigation Menu](/docs/primitives/navigation-menu): Site-navigation menu with list, item, trigger, content, positioner, link, and indicator parts. Its link wrapper closes the menu on click by default. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/navigation-menu`, Registry: [`/r/ui-navigation-menu.json`](/r/ui-navigation-menu.json))
- [Pagination](/docs/primitives/pagination): Navigation landmark with page list, active link, previous and next controls, and an ellipsis marker. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/pagination`, Registry: [`/r/ui-pagination.json`](/r/ui-pagination.json))
- [Popover](/docs/primitives/popover): Non-modal floating panel with trigger, content, header, title, and description parts. Content exposes Base UI positioner alignment and side options. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/popover`, Registry: [`/r/ui-popover.json`](/r/ui-popover.json))
- [Progress](/docs/primitives/progress): Progress root with track, indicator, label, and value slots, backed by Base UI progress state. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/progress`, Registry: [`/r/ui-progress.json`](/r/ui-progress.json))
- [Radio Group](/docs/primitives/radio-group): Radio-group container and radio item, backed by Base UI state and keyboard behavior. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/radio-group`, Registry: [`/r/ui-radio-group.json`](/r/ui-radio-group.json))
- [Resizable](/docs/primitives/resizable): Panel group, panel, and resize handle composition backed by react-resizable-panels. The handle can add its visual grip. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/resizable`, Registry: [`/r/ui-resizable.json`](/r/ui-resizable.json))
- [Scroll Area](/docs/primitives/scroll-area): Scroll container and scrollbar pair backed by Base UI. The scrollbar defaults to vertical orientation. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/scroll-area`, Registry: [`/r/ui-scroll-area.json`](/r/ui-scroll-area.json))
- [Select](/docs/primitives/select): Base UI selection control with popup positioning and scroll controls. When items is omitted, the root collects labels from nested SelectItem children. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/select`, Registry: [`/r/ui-select.json`](/r/ui-select.json))
- [Separator](/docs/primitives/separator): Semantic horizontal or vertical divider backed by Base UI separator. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/separator`, Registry: [`/r/ui-separator.json`](/r/ui-separator.json))
- [Sheet](/docs/primitives/sheet): Dialog-based side panel with configurable edge, default or floating treatment, and optional close button. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/sheet`, Registry: [`/r/ui-sheet.json`](/r/ui-sheet.json))
- [Sidebar](/docs/primitives/sidebar): Collapsible navigation layout with provider state, side and layout variants, menu rows, actions, badges, skeletons, and a useSidebar state hook. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/sidebar`, Registry: [`/r/ui-sidebar.json`](/r/ui-sidebar.json))
- [Skeleton](/docs/primitives/skeleton): Styled placeholder block for content that has not loaded yet. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/skeleton`, Registry: [`/r/ui-skeleton.json`](/r/ui-skeleton.json))
- [Slider](/docs/primitives/slider): Base UI slider with a numeric range and controlled or default values. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/slider`, Registry: [`/r/ui-slider.json`](/r/ui-slider.json))
- [Sonner](/docs/primitives/sonner): Toaster adapter that forwards Sonner ToasterProps and keeps the project theme and visual treatment. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/sonner`, Registry: [`/r/ui-sonner.json`](/r/ui-sonner.json))
- [Spinner](/docs/primitives/spinner): Inline SVG spinner that forwards SVG attributes. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/spinner`, Registry: [`/r/ui-spinner.json`](/r/ui-spinner.json))
- [Switch](/docs/primitives/switch): Base UI switch with default and compact sizes and root state props. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/switch`, Registry: [`/r/ui-switch.json`](/r/ui-switch.json))
- [Table](/docs/primitives/table): Semantic table composition with optional internal scrolling and sticky headers. Rows can opt into keyboard-accessible interaction, and cells accept start, center, or end alignment. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/table`, Registry: [`/r/ui-table.json`](/r/ui-table.json))
- [Tabs](/docs/primitives/tabs): Base UI tabs composition with root orientation and default or line list variants. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/tabs`, Registry: [`/r/ui-tabs.json`](/r/ui-tabs.json))
- [Textarea](/docs/primitives/textarea): Styled native textarea that forwards standard textarea attributes. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/textarea`, Registry: [`/r/ui-textarea.json`](/r/ui-textarea.json))
- [Toggle Group](/docs/primitives/toggle-group): Base UI toggle group with shared variant and size choices, explicit orientation, and configurable spacing between items. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/toggle-group`, Registry: [`/r/ui-toggle-group.json`](/r/ui-toggle-group.json))
- [Toggle](/docs/primitives/toggle): Base UI toggle with default or outline treatment and default, small, or large size. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/toggle`, Registry: [`/r/ui-toggle.json`](/r/ui-toggle.json))
- [Tooltip](/docs/primitives/tooltip): Base UI tooltip root, trigger, popup, and provider. Popup placement is configurable, and provider delay defaults to zero milliseconds. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/ui/tooltip`, Registry: [`/r/ui-tooltip.json`](/r/ui-tooltip.json))

## Observability & App Widgets (53 Components)

- [Agent Icon](/docs/widgets/agent-icon): Renders a stable, name-derived agent mark with filled and outline treatments. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/leaf/agent-icon`, Registry: [`/r/widget-leaf-agent-icon.json`](/r/widget-leaf-agent-icon.json))
- [Animated API Key](/docs/widgets/animated-api-key): Reveals a key value in the context of the label it replaces. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/animated-api-key`, Registry: [`/r/widget-animated-api-key.json`](/r/widget-animated-api-key.json))
- [Brand Logos](/docs/widgets/brand-logos): Exports provider brand marks as individual React components. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/icons/brand-logos`, Registry: [`/r/icon-brand-logos.json`](/r/icon-brand-logos.json))
- [Brand Mark](/docs/widgets/brand-mark): Renders the Framerock three-frame architectural brand mark. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/icons/brand-mark`, Registry: [`/r/icon-brand-mark.json`](/r/icon-brand-mark.json))
- [Code Block](/docs/widgets/code-block): Highlights source text with Shiki and a TypeScript default language. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/code-block`, Registry: [`/r/widget-code-block.json`](/r/widget-code-block.json))
- [Context Chip](/docs/widgets/context-chip): Shows a compact context label with an optional icon and link destination. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/context-chip`, Registry: [`/r/widget-context-chip.json`](/r/widget-context-chip.json))
- [Copy Button](/docs/widgets/copy-button): Copies a supplied value and exposes the copied state through its icon. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/leaf/copy-button`, Registry: [`/r/widget-leaf-copy-button.json`](/r/widget-leaf-copy-button.json))
- [Copy Icon](/docs/widgets/copy-icon): Renders the ready or copied glyph for a copy action. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/leaf/copy-icon`, Registry: [`/r/widget-leaf-copy-icon.json`](/r/widget-leaf-copy-icon.json))
- [Cost Breakdown](/docs/widgets/cost-breakdown): Groups token cost rows into source-defined categories for a resolved reporting range. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/cost-breakdown`, Registry: [`/r/widget-cost-breakdown.json`](/r/widget-cost-breakdown.json))
- [Customer Avatar](/docs/widgets/customer-avatar): Renders the customer identity mark from customer ID and name inputs. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/leaf/customer-avatar`, Registry: [`/r/widget-leaf-customer-avatar.json`](/r/widget-leaf-customer-avatar.json))
- [Data Table](/docs/widgets/data-table): Composes the table toolbar, search, filter, sorting, and pagination helpers used by Framerock tables. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/data-table`, Registry: [`/r/widget-data-table.json`](/r/widget-data-table.json))
- [Dev Bar](/docs/widgets/dev-bar): Displays query and network diagnostics with explicit callbacks for developer actions. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/dev-toolbar`, Registry: [`/r/widget-dev-toolbar.json`](/r/widget-dev-toolbar.json))
- [Eval Scores](/docs/widgets/eval-scores): Renders evaluation score dots, result labels, and score rows for trace results. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/eval-scores`, Registry: [`/r/widget-eval-scores.json`](/r/widget-eval-scores.json))
- [Filter Select](/docs/widgets/filter-select): Provides an option list with an explicit value and change callback. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/data-table`, Registry: [`/r/widget-filter-select.json`](/r/widget-filter-select.json))
- [Foggy Launcher](/docs/widgets/foggy-launcher): Renders the launcher control for the Foggy assistant widget. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/foggy/foggy-widget`, Registry: [`/r/widget-foggy-foggy-widget.json`](/r/widget-foggy-foggy-widget.json))
- [Foggy Message](/docs/widgets/foggy-message): Renders one Foggy conversation message from the widget message model. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/foggy/foggy-message`, Registry: [`/r/widget-foggy-foggy-message.json`](/r/widget-foggy-foggy-message.json))
- [Foggy Widget](/docs/widgets/foggy-widget): Renders the Foggy assistant panel from its controlled widget state and callbacks. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/foggy/foggy-widget`, Registry: [`/r/widget-foggy-foggy-widget.json`](/r/widget-foggy-foggy-widget.json))
- [Foglamp HUD](/docs/widgets/foglamp-hud): Displays live trace, step, token, and tool events from an injected HUD stream. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/hud`, Registry: [`/r/hud-foglamphud.json`](/r/hud-foglamphud.json))
- [Heat Cell](/docs/widgets/heat-cell): Maps a metric value to a percentile bucket and its corresponding table cell treatment. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/heat-cell`, Registry: [`/r/widget-heat-cell.json`](/r/widget-heat-cell.json))
- [HUD Inline Preview](/docs/widgets/hud-inline-preview): Shows the HUD in an inline preview using the HUD event stream contract. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/hud`, Registry: [`/r/hud-foglamphud.json`](/r/hud-foglamphud.json))
- [Logo](/docs/widgets/logo): Renders the product logo with optional size and class overrides. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/icons/logo`, Registry: [`/r/icon-logo.json`](/r/icon-logo.json))
- [Markdown](/docs/widgets/markdown): Renders prose inside the payload inspector. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/payload-view`, Registry: [`/r/widget-markdown.json`](/r/widget-markdown.json))
- [Model Chip](/docs/widgets/model-chip): Displays model and provider labels in a compact chip. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/model-chip`, Registry: [`/r/widget-model-chip.json`](/r/widget-model-chip.json))
- [Model Logo](/docs/widgets/model-logo): Renders a model-provider icon from its model name. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/icons/model-logo`, Registry: [`/r/icon-model-logo.json`](/r/icon-model-logo.json))
- [Node Flow](/docs/widgets/node-flow): Groups sequential agent flow nodes into a compact flow row. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/leaf/node-flow`, Registry: [`/r/widget-leaf-node-flow.json`](/r/widget-leaf-node-flow.json))
- [Page Header](/docs/widgets/page-header): Renders a page title, supporting copy, and optional back navigation. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/page-parts`, Registry: [`/r/widget-page-header.json`](/r/widget-page-header.json))
- [Pagination Footer](/docs/widgets/pagination-footer): Reports the visible row interval and exposes page changes. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/data-table`, Registry: [`/r/widget-pagination-footer.json`](/r/widget-pagination-footer.json))
- [Payload View](/docs/widgets/payload-view): Renders structured payload data as JSON, prose, message parts, and tool calls. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/payload-view`, Registry: [`/r/widget-payload-view.json`](/r/widget-payload-view.json))
- [Project Icon](/docs/widgets/project-icon): Renders a stable project mark with a generated fallback. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/leaf/project-icon`, Registry: [`/r/widget-leaf-project-icon.json`](/r/widget-leaf-project-icon.json))
- [Project Provider](/docs/widgets/project-provider): Provides project selection state to descendants through useProject. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/project-context`, Registry: [`/r/widget-project-context.json`](/r/widget-project-context.json))
- [Prompt Prose](/docs/widgets/prompt-prose): Parses and renders a prompt template with slot examples and token estimates. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/prompt-prose`, Registry: [`/r/widget-prompt-prose.json`](/r/widget-prompt-prose.json))
- [Prompt Version Chip](/docs/widgets/prompt-version-chip): Links to the prompt-version view for an agent. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/prompt-version-chip`, Registry: [`/r/widget-prompt-version-chip.json`](/r/widget-prompt-version-chip.json))
- [Prompt Versions View](/docs/widgets/prompt-versions-view): Compares prompt versions, their templates, and slot values. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/prompt-versions-card`, Registry: [`/r/widget-prompt-versions-card.json`](/r/widget-prompt-versions-card.json))
- [Quota Card](/docs/widgets/quota-card): Displays span quota usage and its current percentage. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/quota-card`, Registry: [`/r/widget-quota-card-view.json`](/r/widget-quota-card-view.json))
- [Range Picker](/docs/widgets/range-picker): Renders the shared reporting range controls and preset choices. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/range-picker`, Registry: [`/r/widget-range-picker.json`](/r/widget-range-picker.json))
- [Range Provider](/docs/widgets/range-provider): Provides shared range state and the setter returned by useRange. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/range-context`, Registry: [`/r/widget-range-context.json`](/r/widget-range-context.json))
- [Relative Time](/docs/widgets/relative-time): Formats a timestamp as relative time. (Import: `@tailrocks/framerock/widgets/leaf/relative-time`, Registry: [`/r/widget-leaf-relative-time.json`](/r/widget-leaf-relative-time.json))
